project_name.description: The project name from the PROJECT box of the title block, e.g. 'TURNBULL SCHOOL MUSIC ROOM ADDITION'

general_contractor.description: The contractor named in the BY box of the title block

fabricator.description: The rebar fabricator who produced the shop drawings, from the title block

name.description: Fabricator name as printed, e.g. 'AGF STEEL - OTTAWA'

address.description: Fabricator street address, city, province and postal code, as one line

contract_number.description: The fabricator's contract number from the CONTRACT NO. box, e.g. 'CP9667F'

sheets.description: One entry per drawing sheet, in page order

sheet_number.description: The sheet number in the bottom-right box of the title block, e.g. 'P1'

drawing_title.description: The DRAWING TITLE from the title block, e.g. 'FOOTING'

latest_revision.description: The highest-numbered row of the revision block (REV / REMARKS / DATE / BY)

engineer_review.description: The structural engineer's shop drawing review stamp (the black SHOP DRAWING REVIEW stamp naming the engineering firm)

firm.description: The engineering firm named on the stamp

status.description: The status whose box is marked on the engineer's stamp

review_date.description: The handwritten DATE on the engineer's stamp, as YYYY-MM-DD

architect_review.description: The architect's red SHOP DRAWING REVIEW stamp

firm.description: The architecture firm named under the stamp

status.description: The status whose box is ticked on the architect's stamp

review_date.description: The Date on the architect's stamp, as YYYY-MM-DD

bar_list.description: Every row of the bar list and bending schedule table on this sheet, in order

bar_size.description: SIZE: the metric bar size, e.g. '15M'

bar_mark.description: BAR MARK, e.g. 'A1'; null for straight bars with no mark

bend_type.description: BND TYP: the bend shape code, e.g. '1', '2', '6', 'T2'; null for straight bars

a.description: Bending dimension A in millimetres, from the A column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

b.description: Bending dimension B in millimetres, from the B column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

c.description: Bending dimension C in millimetres, from the C column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

d.description: Bending dimension D in millimetres, from the D column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

e.description: Bending dimension E in millimetres, from the E column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

g.description: Bending dimension G in millimetres, from the G column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

h.description: Bending dimension H in millimetres, from the H column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

j.description: Bending dimension J in millimetres, from the J column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

k.description: Bending dimension K in millimetres, from the K column of the BENDING DIMENSIONS group; null when the cell is blank

concrete_strengths.description: Rows of the CONCRETE STRENGTHS table on the first sheet

concrete_covers.description: Rows of the CONCRETE COVERS table on the first sheet

location.description: Where the cover applies, e.g. 'FOOTING BOTTOM'

steel_grade.description: The reinforcing steel grade from the DETAILING NOTES, e.g. 'GRADE 400 W'
